description: Ship data products from a laptop — local-first SDK + CLI for Iceberg pipelines.
notes: Nucleus installs into an isolated Python virtualenv at $dir\venv.
First boot of `nucleus up` may take ~30 s (downloads pyiceberg, polars, duckdb, pyarrow wheels).
Quickstart: nucleus init demo && cd demo && nucleus up && nucleus down
PyPI distribution name is `nucleus-data` (the bare `nucleus` name is squatted on PyPI).
pre_install: # Create an isolated venv inside the Scoop install dir so we never
# pollute the user's system Python and so `scoop uninstall nucleus`
# is a clean rmdir. The Python 3.11 dep is provided by main/python311.
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'NUCLEUS-INSTALL: failed to create virtualenv (Python 3.11 missing?)' }

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'NUCLEUS-INSTALL: pip install failed (see scoop log above)' }

post_install: # Smoke test — fail loudly if the entry point is missing.
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'NUCLEUS-INSTALL: nucleus --version returned non-zero; install incomplete' }
